manifest.purpose: The golden answer file for the analysis_report submission. Contains exactly three keys: vulnerability_found (true), vulnerable_component (string identifying the early_done comparator logic), and recommended_fix (string describing removal of early-termination and forcing fixed-latency operation for all word-width iterations). Must satisfy FR1-FR4 and SR1-SR2. The evaluator overlays this file onto submission/vulnerability_report.json and grades its content against the hidden acceptance criteria.
